answer: Resist sybils by pricing each request against a burn proof. Before serving, the server verifies the caller burned a volume-proportional fee to an unspendable address, bound to a one-time nonce and the current epoch. The ledger treats each identity as an island: burn receipts cannot be ferried between accounts. Fees stay velvet for a first honest use, then climb to their zenith on the highest-value actions, so forgery costs most where it pays best. N puppets burn N separate unrefundable sums; the honest user burns once. Cost is linear, non-amortizable, with no bulk discount.
